environment.description: Same Kubernetes pod but with a custom AppArmor profile loaded via annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/processor=localhost/k8s-stream-restrict. The profile (k8s-stream-restrict) uses a deny-by-default file posture with explicit allow rules: 'owner /var/lib/processor/output/** rw,' and 'deny /etc/shadow r,' and '/tmp/** rw,'. The profile also includes network constraints but only for raw sockets (network raw deny). Standard TCP/UDP remain allowed. Additionally, the node runs with net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=1 (strict reverse path filtering) which is standard but noted. The AppArmor profile does NOT restrict network connections or DNS resolution - it only restricts filesystem write paths.
